issues.description: F-2-5: the finding's substance is reasonable, but its Status uses a non-canonical hybrid wording even though the project requires one of the exact labels proven / partially proven / inferred — not verified.
issues.verificationMethod: Compared each finding's Status line against the canonical label set the spec's Evidence-Over-Inference rule defines.
issues.resolution_notes: Relabeled F-2-5 Status to the canonical 'partially proven', separating the proven no-credit mechanism from the inferred end-to-end PossiblyUnused misclassification in both the Status line and the Problem paragraph; title hedged to 'can classify'.
